create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 rho-large Farey-covector reduction
create.statement_tex: Fix the exact accepted Round-191 hard-M1 t=1 rho-large remainder with Q=H_B, U=mq>4Q, q>Q, m|a|_q>Q, Qm<Y, the inherited fast dyadic projective band, U|u, and every literal field under one outer real part. For v0=[v]_U let rho v0-beta U=1 be the signed least-inverse identity and put T=min((U-1)/2,floor(QmU/Y)). Fix C0>=2, A=min(U-1,floor(Q^C0)), F_A={(c,d):1<=c<=A,0<=d<=c,(c,d)=1}, and ell_(c,d)=c beta-d rho. For T>=1 let P_A select the single union with |ell_(c,d)|<=T for some (c,d) in F_A; for T=0 set P_A=0. The identity rho(c v0-dU)=c+U ell_(c,d) is nonzero for c<U, and each fixed (c,d,ell) has at most 2 tau(|c+U ell|) canonical classes. After literal repetitions, Y heights, kappa sites, the fixed A^2 polylogarithmic cost, the exact m^(-1)c_q(a) lift, coefficient mass, bands, divisor ledger, and shell sum, |P_A R_fix|<<Qm kappa u X^epsilon and its outer contribution is <<L^2X^epsilon. The exact decomposition is J_safe,192,fix=J_safe,191,fix+P_A R_fix and R_core,fix=(I-P_A)R_fix, with no terminal or Fejer double count. For T>=1 every core row satisfies |c beta-d rho|>T for all F_A and |rho|>=(A+1)(T+1); the core is empty if floor(((U-1)/2)/(A+1))<=T, equivalently U<=2(A+1)(T+1)-1. For literal v=v0+nU, gamma=beta+n rho; with d_v=cn+d and Delta=cv-d_v U, rho Delta=c+U ell, gamma Delta=d_v+v ell, and the exact phase, carry, and unequal endpoint number/divisor translations retain all literal fields. Long-step Abel is a self-return. A coefficient-blind positive Farey cover restores the Y/(Qm) deficit in the qualified unsaturated residue-universe control, and bounded arrays retain full capacity; neither is literal lower mass. The nonempty core estimate remains open. This node proves only the strict Farey union, exact core reduction, coverage corollaries, and method boundary, not complete rho-large, complete t=1, a parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent.
create.next_action: Prove the exact core remainder. For T=0 retain the entire Round-191 rho-large remainder. For T>=1 retain simultaneously |rho|>=(A+1)(T+1) and |c beta-d rho|>T for every primitive 1<=c<=A, 0<=d<=c, while preserving the fast J-band, both orientations, every literal mask, unequal endpoint number/divisor translation, canonical carry, square-root phase, affine birth/death, coprimality flip, and zero extension under one outer real part. Establish a jointly signed fixed-packet estimate <<Qm kappa u X^epsilon, gaining Y/(Qm) before positive norms. Static Farey separation, long-step Abel, positive covering, or bounded-array capacity alone is insufficient.

reject.reason: For v=v0+nU the literal transport quotient is gamma=beta+n rho; the static Farey selector must use canonical beta.
The nonzero divisor factor requires 1<=c<U; allowing c=U permits the congruence argument to fail.
The lawful bound is by signed divisors, at most 2 tau(|c+U ell|), not one class.
When the density budget is below one class the new selector is defined empty; no isolated ell=0 row is charged to it.
P_A is a single union indicator; the covector sum is used only for an upper bound and each selected row enters the complex projection once.
The family has O(A^2)<=O(Q^(2C0)) members and is absorbed only because Q is polylogarithmic and C0 is fixed.
Outside the exact empty-core criterion a simultaneous badly approximable core remains; positive covering requires sector cost.
The lower bound |rho|>=(A+1)(T+1) is only a support restriction and supplies no signed cancellation for actual coefficients.
The transported mode phase is e(epsilon ac/q), independent of ell in magnitude, and can be resonant.
The cumulative carry is theta-epsilon ell; its parity has no separation or averaging supplied by the core condition.
The two endpoint number/divisor translations are unequal, depend on the literal representative through d_v, and can change every arithmetic and profile mask.
For finite or absolutely summable zero-extended heights the normalized long difference returns exactly to the original height sum.
In the qualified unsaturated residue-universe control about U/T asymptotic to Y/(Qm) target-sized pieces are needed, restoring the deficit.
Arbitrary bounded-array extremizers need not be realized by the actual endpoint coefficients and do not lower-bound or disprove the literal core.
The nonempty core, complete t=1 residual, every t>=2 range, all parents, bridges, the target, and every exponent remain open or unchanged.
